g.text: CoT forgery in AgentDojo tool outputs · Held-out test traces (n = 9)
Fixed 16-head, six-role MLP probe. Points: trace means; diamonds/bars: mean and paired trace-bootstrap 95% CI.
Payload types receive equal weight within each trace. Full-payload contrast changes text composition; native reasoning is a reference.
